usageNotes: Marks a replication job for removal and, by default, cleans up the replicated snapshots on the target. Use `force=true` to remove only the job configuration immediately without waiting for or performing cleanup — useful when the target is unreachable. Use `keep=true` to leave replicated data on the target intact (e.g., when repurposing the replica). Requires VM.Replicate on the guest's /vms/<vmid> path.

examples.summary: Delete replication job 105-0, cleaning up replicated data on the target

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the replication job configuration and, unless `keep=true` is set, deletes the replicated snapshots from the target node — removing the offsite copy of the guest.
tips: If the target node is offline or unreachable, use `force=true` to remove the job config without attempting cleanup; manually remove leftover snapshots on the target later.
Set `keep=true` when you want to promote the replica (e.g., the source was destroyed) — the replicated snapshots remain and can be used to restore or migrate the guest.
The job ID format is '<VMID>-<JOBNUM>' (e.g., '105-0'); VMID must be 3–9 digits starting with 1–9, and JOBNUM 1–9 digits.
